elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason” and requires TrueLink, at Client's request, to “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: Subsection (a) expressly provides transition assistance “for up to 6 months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must return all Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) requires TrueLink to “return to Client all Client Content and other Client data” upon expiration or termination.

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) requires return “within 30 days of such expiration or termination,” rather than measuring the deadline from a later request.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) expressly requires “a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor must delete it from its systems.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires TrueLink to “thereafter delete such Client Content and data from its systems.”

elements.element: After deletion, Vendor must certify the deletion to Customer.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires TrueLink to “certify such deletion to Client in writing.”

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires TrueLink to provide transition assistance at Client's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: The clause makes assistance available for up to 6 months, which encompasses a requested 90-day transition period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must export Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must return all Client Content and other Client data to Client in a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: The Customer Data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The return deadline is expressly “within 30 days of such expiration or termination.”

result.reason: The operative addition fully implements the preferred position and therefore also the fallback. It addresses only transition assistance, data return, deletion, and certification, without altering the existing termination mechanics or adding unrelated commercial obligations.
